2026-11-05ESDC, TBFinancial Administration ActRemission Order to Remit Debts in Respect of Canada Pension Plan Disability Benefits Reassessment DelaysRemission Order to Remit Debts in Respect of Canada Pension Plan Disability Benefits Reassessment Delays in order to (1) remit the debt of any individual who received payments for the Disability Pension or the Post-retirement Disability Benefit (PRDB) under certain conditions; and (2) remit any amount of the Disabled Contributor's Child's Benefit that was overpaid due to ineligibility for the Disability Pension or the PRDB.N/A
subject: Remission Order to Remit Debts in Respect of Canada Pension Plan Disability Benefits Reassessment Delays
precis: Remission Order to Remit Debts in Respect of Canada Pension Plan Disability Benefits Reassessment Delays in order to (1) remit the debt of any individual who received payments for the Disability Pension or the Post-retirement Disability Benefit (PRDB) under certain conditions; and (2) remit any amount of the Disabled Contributor's Child's Benefit that was overpaid due to ineligibility for the Disability Pension or the PRDB.
